prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic fashion magazine cover featuring an adult woman seated in a relaxed editorial pose on a sculptural cream sofa. She wears an avant-garde high-fashion look with an asymmetrical black blazer, silk textures, bold tailoring and statement heels; use an approved wardrobe reference when attached. Style her with glossy lips, dewy realistic skin, subtle dramatic eye makeup and natural hair movement. Use soft diffused studio light with a luxury glow, a minimal beige or cream studio background and refined fashion shadows. Add a generic or licensed magazine masthead, headline The New Power Aesthetic and subtext MIRA — where influence meets couture. Render 8K high-fashion editorial realism without public-figure likeness or unlicensed branding.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, illegible cover text, invented magazine logo
